knob: top-level reasoning_effort: trtllm-serve's kimi_k3 serving extension maps low, high and max to chat_template_kwargs.thinking_effort (the encoder's thinking-effort system message) and leaves any other value to the encoder's default, max. The model card documents the same field and levels (default max).

levels.off: not offered: K3 always thinks; pi clamps off to minimal

notes: reasoning_effort 'none' would turn K3's thinking off (the extension maps it to thinking=false); the preset never sends it, so thinking stays on. 'minimal' and 'xhigh' are not values the Chat request model accepts (400), so they are never sent as such.
